root_idea.summary: The root centers on intense heat, vehement blazing, and the resulting sense of fiery intensity.
root_idea.development: The fiery sense extends to the Qur'anic name جَحِيم for Hellfire, to intensely hot places and the vehemence of battle, and metaphorically to glowing or forcefully opened eyes, anger, desire, and constriction of disposition.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic noun جَحِيم is a distinct lexical item and is attested 26 times.

senses.definition: A vehemently blazing or great fire.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the word can evoke the fire's intense blazing character, including in renderings such as “the blazing Fire.”

senses.definition: The Hellfire; the fire of Hell.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Quran as the designation of the eschatological fire of punishment, often with the definite article but also in indefinite constructions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of fire: to burn, burn up, blaze, or become vehement, with many live coals and much flame.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The same description can be applied to war when it becomes vehement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To kindle a fire; to make it burn, blaze, or flame fiercely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I use referring to causing the fire to burn.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To refrain, desist, abstain, or draw back from something; also, in contrary usage, to advance or go forward.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The retreating sense is reported as a rare dialectal variant of أَحْجَمَ, while opposed usage is also recorded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be near destroying or killing someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a separate transitive construction from أَجْحَمَ عَنْهُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To burn with vehement desire, covetousness, or niggardliness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form V use expressing inward fiery intensity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become straitened in disposition; to become difficult or constricted toward others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction تَجَحَّمَ عَلَيْنَا is explained as becoming straitened in disposition against us.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The intense burning, blazing, or flaming of fire; also an epithet of fire because of its redness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The redness is presented as a characteristic associated with vehemently burning fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An eye, especially a glowing or fiery eye; the two eyes of a lion are called جَحْمَتَا الأَسَدِ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This eye sense is distinct from the fire-related noun جَحْمَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fire with flames rising one above another, abundant live coals, or the form of a great fire in a pit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are broader Classical descriptions of the fire-name beyond the general Quranic designation of Hellfire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Niggardly, tenacious, stingy, penurious, or avaricious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective is connected with the straitness and vehemence of war.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An eye disease that causes the eyes to swell.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical or medical Classical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To open the eyes wide in a fixed stare; to direct an intense gaze at someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression جَحَّمَنِي بِعَيْنِهِ means that he fixed an intense gaze on me.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A staring or intensely open eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the eye-related use of the feminine form, distinct from its fire-related use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having eyes that are intensely red and wide.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: جَحْمَاءُ is the feminine form; the description concerns the eyes' redness and breadth, not the person's gender as a semantic restriction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Live coals burning or blazing fiercely; also a place that is intensely hot.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression may be used tropically of death by likening it to a fiercely burning fire.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The main or thick part of a battle; its straitness, vehemence, or the intensity of fighting and slaughter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression اِصْطَلَى بِجَاحِمِ الحَرْبِ means to experience the heat or vehemence of battle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fire, or fire burning, blazing, or flaming fiercely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine fire epithet related to intense blazing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of the face, to blaze or become flushed from intense anger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension from the heat and upsurge of a blazing fire.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers burning, blazing, and becoming vehement.
Covers kindling or causing fire to burn.
Covers withdrawal and the reported contrary sense of advance.
Covers nearing the destruction or killing of someone.
Covers burning with desire, covetousness, and niggardliness.
Covers intense fire and its redness.
Covers the intensely blazing or great fire and the Quranic name of Hellfire, along with narrower Classical fire descriptions.
Covers the adjective for stinginess and avarice.
Covers fiercely burning coals, intensely hot places, and the recorded tropical comparison involving death.
Covers the intense or central part and vehemence of battle.

cautions: أَجْحَمَ عَنْهُ is reported with opposed meanings: withdrawal or advance. The withdrawal sense is explicitly treated as a rare dialectal variant related to أَحْجَمَ and is not part of the Quranic noun جَحِيم.
